errors.evidence: The x-axis on the chart ends at 2021Q4, not 2020Q4.

errors.text_span: с равномерно разположени етикети на всеки четири тримесечия
errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are not spaced at regular intervals of four quarters. For example, the labels go from 2003Q1 to 2004Q2 (5 quarters), and from 2006Q4 to 2008Q1 (5 quarters).

errors.text_span: Линията започва в 2003Q1 с приблизителна стойност 430,0
errors.evidence: The line starts at a value of approximately 500 in 2003Q1, not 430.0.
The description misidentifies the first local minimum. The actual minimum occurs around 2008Q4/2009Q1 with a value below 200 (approximately 180).

errors.text_span: След това линията се покачва до около 420,0 в 2011Q4
errors.evidence: This is not the peak. The actual peak occurs later, around 2013Q1, with a higher value of approximately 450-460. The point in 2011Q4 is on the rising trend, not the peak itself.
The value on the chart at 2016Q4 is approximately 220, not 180.0.

errors.text_span: През 2019 г. линията показва един връх около 250,0
errors.evidence: In 2019, the line shows a trough (a local minimum), not a peak ('връх'). The value at this minimum (in 2019Q2) is approximately 130, not 250.0.
The description stops at 2020Q4, but the chart data continues to 2021Q4. The final point in 2021Q4 is around 150, not 180.

errors.text_span: в рамките на диапазон между 160,0 и 240,0
errors.evidence: The actual range of the line in the period from 2016Q4 to 2020Q4 is approximately from a minimum of 130 (in 2019Q2) to a maximum of 220 (in 2016Q4). The stated range of [160, 240] is incorrect.
